title: A real transformer procurement package
caption: Five complete public documents. One equipment scope. Every proposal stays linked to its source.
narration: TenderProof helps engineering and procurement teams check whether equipment commitments match the documents. This case uses five complete public documents for a Guam Power Authority transformer purchase. The source inspector retains the original document, page references and file hash.

title: The original document stays one click away
caption: Original purchase order, page 4. Item 2 contains three 750 kVA transformers.
narration: Here is the actual purchase order, with the original page available beside the proposal. Our scope is item two: three seven hundred fifty k V A transformers. The separate three hundred k V A item is excluded.

title: Apertus proposes. Reviewers decide.
caption: 35 pending requirements and 4 pending offers. Input coverage does not establish correctness.
narration: Apertus eight B ran on a local GPU. The full fifty seven page tender took four hundred twenty seven seconds. It produced mixed quality results, including wrong scope and prices. Thirty five requirements and four offers remain pending.

title: A correction preserves the original output
caption: USD 111,316.50 lot total became USD 37,105.50 per unit. The proposal remains pending.
narration: The model confused a three unit line total with a unit price. The recorded correction cites purchase order page four. The line total becomes thirty seven thousand one hundred five dollars and fifty cents per unit. Both the original model value and correction reason stay visible. This is an assistant source reading, still awaiting qualified review.

title: Incomplete extraction blocks release
caption: Failed audits, omitted obligations and capped output remain unresolved conditions.
narration: The full tender run also had a truncated audit and an output cap. Those conditions now persist with the source and exact package snapshot. Reviewing individual rows cannot clear missing obligations. Both purchase and shipment release remain blocked while extraction assurance is incomplete.

title: Missing factory evidence stays unknown
caption: No applicable FAT report, serial evidence or approved unit drawing. No release has occurred.
narration: The public package contains test requirements, but no completed factory acceptance report for the actual unit. TenderProof keeps that evidence unknown. The gate cannot create a shipment decision from missing proof, and this case has no approvals or releases.

title: A reproducible workbench for engineering review
caption: 330 backend tests. 39 frontend tests. Next: expert evaluation with a design partner.
narration: State survives restarts, with all tests passing. The next step is expert evaluation with a design partner.
